identity: The Whispering Reedlands charge a toll for every crossing, and the mirefolk collect it.

quests.title: Something for the Carriers
quests.text: Every load at Whisperreed Landing seems to be urgent until I ask when its carriers last ate. Bring me four Melons for the people doing the lifting. The trade can wait while they have a slice.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Who Disputes the Claim
quests.text: The toll-takers claim the water as if they dug the whole course themselves. Speak to Enashi Reedvoice at Reedvoice Station; she knows the crossings and the people being charged to use them. She has been asking who gave those collectors permission, and they dislike the question.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: An Invitation to Speargrass
quests.text: Brakka Jarward at Speargrass Wellhold keeps the working crews fed, and our exchange depends on the work they do. Go and speak to her in Speargrass Reach. Tell her Taleko sent willing hands, which are more useful than another promise about the next load.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: An Invitation to Ossuary
quests.text: Sovel Namekeeper at Ossuary Ledgerstead takes care that old belongings and old names reach the right people. Go and offer help in Ossuary Reach. We send loads through many hands here; Sovel reminds me why the name at the end matters.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: That Is No Floating Log
quests.text: My stone carriers keep finding Logbacks where they hoped to find a place to set down their load. Kill six in the {name:mudbanks}. If a log turns to watch you approach, do not give it the benefit of the doubt.
quests.lesson: A use at a place or a day hunt; the first armor choice (one enchant, a prefix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Signs for the Crossings
quests.text: A carrier with both hands full should not have to wave down a stranger to learn which crossing they have reached. Bring me six Wooden Signs for the exchange routes. I will make the lettering large enough to read over a sack.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people.
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. Free play, a level only.

quests.title: Loosen the Held Bundles
quests.text: The toll-takers have tied up other people's provisions and left them at the {name:seized_stores} in the {name:reedbanks}. Free the bundles there and report to me so their owners can collect them. A knot around a load does not make its contents belong to whoever tied it.
quests.completion: The stores are ready to go back to their owners. I will see that the people waiting for them hear where to collect.
quests.lesson: A later errand or use; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The check's fix: the place stands in the open (the Reedbanks), not in Hushwater Nests, whose members stand up to 24 nodes from its centre.

quests.title: The River Has No Purse
quests.text: Mirefolk Tollkeeper Ush charges for every crossing he can hold, though the boat crews do the work and mend the landings. Kill him at the {name:mire_nests}, {dir_from_giver:mire_nests}, and return to me. He says the water demands payment; I have heard only his voice asking.
quests.completion: Ush will make no more demands at our crossings. The people who keep them usable can get back to their work without paying him for the privilege.
quests.lesson: The named leader; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged).

quests.title: Standards at Bannerbreak
quests.text: Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa keeps the colours fit to carry while the fighting wears everything down. Go and offer her help. She knows how much work stands behind a banner that still holds together.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 60 BANDQUESTS. The departure id stays; free from 29, it requires nothing.
